notes.title: IRON GUARD: Salvation - We're back with lots of news ahead!
notes.content: [h3][b]Hi there! We're back — and we have some good news ✨[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36376107/00b1941c2fd7ef59d97e8801e34a768a13199a66.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The second patch for the [url="https://www.meta.com/experiences/iron-guard-salvation/5651010038313251/"]MetaQuest Store version[/url] is just around the corner. Thanks to Quest players we’ve received a lot of feedback, which helped us not only fix issues but also improve some elements of gameplay and controls. [/p][p][/p][p]Very soon the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest/"]Next Fest[/url] will kick off, and we’ll do our best to participate and prepare a demo. In addition, we’ll now be regularly sharing news about the game: talking about new features, showing gameplay shots, and sharing our plans.[/p][p][/p][p]In [b]October[/b], we’ll be working on porting the game to [b]SteamVR[/b]. So stay tuned, add the game to wishlist, tell your friends, and keep an eye out for updates 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861410/IRON_GUARD_Salvation/" style="button"]Wishlist now![/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36376107/ae67fba3089944bd80118516ac36593c9e5fa34d.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: IRON GUARD is now available on the Meta Quest Store!
notes.content:
Today is an important day for us - [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5153768677983339/]IRON GUARD is now available on the Meta Quest Store![/url]

For this we had to work hard to hit this milestone, but the great news is that now the game performs even better. Those who have already tried the game on Applab, you should see this difference considerably, especially if you are a  Quest 1 owner.

Here is a list of the main changes included in the Meta Store released version:

[list]
[*] Changed the teleport
[*] Improved performance and visuals
[*] Increased the brightness of some dark maps
[*] Changed the effect of taking damage
[*] Reduced build weight to <900 MB
[*] Changed the design of some elements
[*] Added the ability to change the height of the player (under settings in level)
[*] Reduced loading time
[/list]

Thank you for your time! We are glad you'll be joining us on this exciting adventure, because this is just beginning!

notes.title: Patch 4 and the addition of new languages!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After a brief lull, we are finally pleased to announce the largest (and final) patch #4! 

[b]Main update:[/b] added new translations for the texts: [b]German, Spanish[/b] and [b]Chinese[/b] simplified. Hopefully this will help more players immerse themselves in the story and the atmosphere of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36376107/8dac8f5d8b111b6fd24bb1b73befe906b5caa38c.png[/img]

The list of all various edits and changes are simply too long, so we have listed some basic categories for the fixes:
[list]
[*] Graphic bugs fixed

[*] Sound bugs fixed

[*] Optimized some shaders

[*] Improved some interface elements, increased fonts and dialog boxes

[*] Added additional player rotation options

[*] The game will now automatically pause if you remove the VR headset

[*] Many (more than a hundred) other minor fixes
[/list]
We tried to accommodate many of your suggestions and wishes in this patch and we do not plan to release new ones anytime soon, however, if you find any issues, please let us know about them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rYtwQYz]Discord server[/url], if necessary, we will definitely release a hotfix. Special thanks to everyone who left suggestions and actively helped us with feedback and testing! Your help was invaluable!

We hope that we will be able to achieve much success and the much needed popularity of our game on Steam soon, so that the sets of cards, icons and backgrounds for the profile become available, as they are already ready and awaiting being unlocked.

We would for sure love to continue working on the game, add new levels, add multiplayer support and so on, but for that it's necessary that a lot more people know about our game, especially on Youtube and Twitch. Therefore, we look forward to any help and support from our community and players, streamers and content creators to help support us.

Lastly, [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5153768677983339/]we just released IRON GUARD VR on Oculus AppLab[/url] and hope that we will soon be able to get into the Oculus Quest store, wish us luck! Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36376107/0ebf808c3a70d34ce015ac74b7837f1463f4c8fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
We are glad to announce patch 3 release, there are many fixes and improvements:

• Fixed some sound issues

• Fixed some visual bugs

• Added HP Reverb G2 support

• Fixed navigation arrows issue on some levels

• Fixed ground level 

• Some achievement fixes

• Fixed a bug due to which additional SP was incorrectly credited after replaying a level

• Added indicators to every completed level on the missions map to make it easier to track the number of stars received

Some fixes are difficult to test as there are many headsets and controllers, so if you find any problems, please report it to us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1213220/discussions/]forum[/url] or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/rYtwQYz]Discord server[/url]. Thanks!

Next we're working to support additional languages and release on Viveport. Thank you!
